desc: Derive per-pair contribution as a function of k and reduce total change to per-element delta (N-2i-1) at transition k=M-1-A_i.
Express answer(k) = inv0 + diff[M-k] via prefix sums over bucket[A_i+1].
Implement O(N log M + M) solution in Python.
Edge cases covered: M=1, N=1, duplicates, diff[M]=0 invariance.
